description: This file defines a class CandidateAllowedActionAPI, which is an API endpoint managing allowed actions for a recruitment candidate within the OrangeHRM system. It includes logic to fetch permissible workflow actions based on candidate ID, candidate vacancy status, user roles, and interview counts.
